---
title: "Budget and Revenue"
---
```{python}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")
```

Films with bigger budgets tend to earn more worldwide, as @fig-budget shows.

```{python}
#| label: fig-budget
#| fig-cap: "Budget against worldwide revenue (millions of USD)"
#| echo: true
plt.scatter(films["budget_musd"], films["revenue_musd"])
plt.xlabel("Budget (million USD)")
plt.ylabel("Revenue (million USD)")
plt.show()
```
